answer: Agents stake capital into a shared orchard whose leaves commit to identity proofs, and a recursive STARK folds each epoch's membership claims into one succinct beacon that anchors cross-agent trust without revealing secrets. A new agent must submit a plume of attestations signed by distinct, already-verified peers, so fabricated identities cannot self-bootstrap into. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
